lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Gray mountains stand like giants in the mist
He walks the path that time has kissed
A heavy pack upon a weary back
Following the lines of a dusty track
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets to the stones
He carries the weight of the marrow in his bones
[Chorus]
The road is long and the valley is wide
With the spirit of the wild deep inside
He climbs the ridge where the shadows grow tall
Standing steady through the rise and the fall
[Verse]
The river carves a canyon deep and wide
Where the secrets of the ancient waters hide
Each step is a promise kept to the ground
In the silence where the true strength is found
[Pre-Chorus]
The sky turns heavy with a coming rain
Washing away the dust and the lingering pain
[Chorus]
The road is long and the valley is wide
With the spirit of the wild deep inside
He climbs the ridge where the shadows grow tall
Standing steady through the rise and the fall
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The stars ignite like sparks in the night
Guiding his feet toward the morning light
[Chorus]
The road is long and the valley is wide
With the spirit of the wild deep inside
He climbs the ridge where the shadows grow tall
Standing steady through the rise and the fall
[Outro]
